events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: First of all, a huge THANK YOU to everyone who has played our demo and shared their feedback!We've been listening closely to your suggestions, reports, and comments, and we've spent the last few days making a ton of changes and improvements to the game!From gameplay adjustments and quality-of-life improvements to bug fixes and tutorial refinements, we've been working hard to make the experience smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable.And we're not stopping here!Your feedback is incredibly valuable

events.title: THE DEMO IS OUT NOW
events.summary: The demo for Southern Lights: Broken Frequency has been live for 24 hours. Some crews are still holding on. Others have already discovered how unforgiving Antarctica can be. ❄️Have you begun your expedition yet?🎮 Play the Southern Lights: Broken Frequency demo for free on Steam💬 Tell us how far you got❤️ Wishlist the full game, launching November 2The station is waiting—and its mysteries are only beginning to unravel.#SouthernLights #SteamDemo #IndieGame #StrategyGame #Lovecraftian #IndieDev

events.title: Southern Lights Demo Launches October 1
events.summary: We’re excited to announce that the Southern Lights demo is coming October 1st!You will finally be able to take your first steps into the frozen world of Southern Lights and experience this ominous journey.The demo will give you a first look at the game’s core mechanics, atmosphere, characters, and the challenges waiting beneath the Antarctic ice.We’ve been working hard to bring the world, systems, and story of the game together, and October will mark an important milestone for the project.Whethe
